submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Produce ONE independently drawn production animation cel for 15_water_dragon_scholar_boy, hit/E/03. This is a targeted continuation of existing work: retain the prior six-frame hit plan and repair the previously wrong facing direction.
REFERENCE INPUTS: image 1 is the authoritative EAST idle sprite for camera, scale and silhouette. Image 2 is the original character identity/costume reference: anatomical RIGHT hand holds the ivory blue-water-dragon fan; LEFT hand is empty; jade pendant stays on anatomical LEFT hip. Image 3 is the approved primary hand-painted style reference only, ignore its UI and other characters.
Canvas: square native 1024x1024 or larger, true transparent RGBA. One full-body figure, no sprite sheet. Fixed orthographic EAST profile, looking toward screen RIGHT, NOSE POINTS RIGHT, hair bun behind head to screen LEFT. Do not turn toward camera or left. Use image 1 standing size and shared virtual floor at 92% canvas height, root centered at 50% width; keep all hair, boots and tassels inside canvas. Maintain the existing rounded chibi large head, short body, navy straight hair, blue eyes, turquoise-gold hair ornament and blue tassels; water-blue/ivory robes with gold wave/cloud borders, blue-gold boots and the same open water-dragon fan.
POSE: hit reaction frame 03/06, recoil peak. Force arrives from screen right. Both boots stay planted, knees flex visibly and separately under lifted robe hem. Hips remain above the two feet. Chest, shoulders and head lean backward toward screen LEFT about 12 degrees but nose still points RIGHT. Chin rises slightly, brows pinch, eyes squint from the hit. Anatomical right wrist grips the black fan pivot firmly and clearly; the open fan is pulled protectively to the chest on screen RIGHT. Anatomical left empty arm reaches slightly backward to screen LEFT for balance, elbow bent, a relaxed clearly drawn open hand. Exactly two hands and two legs; no fused fingers, extra limbs or disconnected fan. Sleeves articulate from shoulders and elbows. Cloth and tassels trail slightly right from the recoil.
Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted finish at the maximum available visual quality. Preserve original identity and costume construction. No backdrop, checkerboard, ground, shadow, text, labels, particles, aura, magic dragon, splash or motion blur. No mirroring, duplicate poses or whole-figure warping.
